source_refs.note: Standalone Playwright (Node, isolated browser context) driven via Bash - not the shared MCP playwright profile, to avoid conflict with the parallel store1 storefront-explorer

assumptions: Đọc TIB_STORE_URL_2 / TIB_STORE_PASSWORD từ .env qua process.env (không có sẵn trong shell mặc định, phải `source .env` thủ công); giá trị không bao giờ được in ra output.

Giả định 'campaign_id 2595' (do orchestrator cung cấp) tương ứng với Shopify product_id quan sát được 15280333291824 trên store2, dựa trên việc URL sản phẩm + campaign API call đều gắn với chính product này ngay sau ACT-07-01-001 — KHÔNG có xác nhận độc lập thứ hai (vd GraphQL platform_linked_id) từ phía storefront-explorer này.
unknowns: TIB_STORE_PASSWORD chỉ dài 2 ký tự alpha, không có khoảng trắng thừa để trim (khác với gợi ý trong prompt) — hoạt động bình thường (gate được vượt qua) nhưng nguồn gốc/độ tin cậy của giá trị này chưa xác minh.

Có/không có phụ phí (additional charge) khi chọn template hoặc option khác — chỉ quan sát 1 mẫu (template 2, 1 bộ lựa chọn) không có phụ phí; biến CSS --tee-additional-charge-bg-color tồn tại trong stylesheet của widget nhưng không được kích hoạt trong lần quan sát này. Một sample duy nhất → LOW confidence, không suy tổng quát.
Không rõ có giảm giá theo số lượng (bulk discount) hay không — chỉ test quantity 1->2, giá tăng tuyến tính đúng 2x, một sample duy nhất.
Chưa rõ hành vi của template 1 và template 3 (bộ field cá nhân hoá có thể khác template 2 đã test).
Chưa rõ hành vi khi đổi variant (Color=White, Size=24"x36") có ảnh hưởng gì đến giá hay cấu hình personalization không.

Chưa xác minh liệu cart drawer có tự động mở (auto-open) sau khi add-to-cart hay không trong môi trường headless (chỉ xác nhận qua sections.cart-drawer HTML trả về trong response, không quan sát trực quan cart drawer overlay mở trên trang).

conflicts.description: Tên nhóm option cấp cha trong campaign là 'Poster - Woman and dog clipart template' (nói tới 'dog') nhưng các field cá nhân hoá bên trong lại dùng nhãn 'Choose Cat Breed #1/#2', 'Cat Name #1/#2' (nói tới 'cat'). Không rõ đây là copy sai của merchant khi tạo campaign hay là cách đặt tên nội bộ không nhất quán của hệ thống.

evidence_refs.note: Heading 'Poster - Woman and dog clipart template' cùng khung với các field 'Choose Cat Breed'

storefront_context.market: NOT_OBSERVED (single default market, no market switcher exercised)
storefront_context.browser: Headless Chromium 153 (standalone Playwright, isolated context - not the shared MCP profile)
storefront_context.device_or_viewport: Desktop 1280x1400-1600 (no mobile/tablet viewport tested this run)

surfaces: PERSONALIZATION (inline in product form, not modal-triggered)
CART_DRAWER (verified via returned section HTML, not visually confirmed open)

observations.observed_result: Redirected to /password (Shopify storefront password gate). Filled password input with TIB_STORE_PASSWORD (trimmed of trailing whitespace, value never logged) and submitted. Gate passed on first attempt - redirected off /password.
observations.state_after: Password-gate session cookie set (not persisted to output); free navigation to storefront pages

observations.action: Load product page after password gate passed
observations.observed_result: Page loaded successfully (HTTP 200). window.Shopify.theme = {name: 'test-data', schema_name: 'Generated Data Theme', schema_version: '1.0.0', role: 'main'}. Body classes include 'teeinblue-enabled teeinblue-product-15280333291824 teeinblue-theme-modern'. Page title 'QA Explore Campaign PB 01 – linh-explorer-2'.
observations.state_after: Product page fully rendered with campaign 2595 content

observations.action: Inspect loaded <script> tags and console output
observations.observed_result: Script tags include https://staging-sdk.teeinblue.com/shopify/app-v2.js?token=[REDACTED]&shop=linh-explorer-2.myshopify.com and https://staging-sdk.teeinblue.com/async.js?platform=shopify&v=2&token=[REDACTED]&shop=linh-explorer-2.myshopify.com. Browser console logged a styled message 'Teeinblue status: running'. This is direct evidence the storefront is running SDK v2 (filename 'app-v2.js' and explicit v=2 query param), consistent with the sdk_version:2 hint from the portal instance 613 response mentioned by orchestrator.

observations.action: Observe network call to teeinblue campaign API triggered automatically on page load
observations.observed_result: GET https://staging-api.teeinblue.com/api/merchant/campaigns/15280333291824.json?shop=linh-explorer-2.myshopify.com returned HTTP 200 and the personalization widget rendered from it (poster template choices, artwork mockup) with no visible error, loading-forever, or 'still publishing' state. This is the first-ever load of campaign 2595 on store2 following its publish in this same run (ACT-07-01-001) - propagation was IMMEDIATE, no additional wait/publish/cache-invalidation step was needed on the storefront-explorer side (a fresh, cold browser session, ~minutes after publish).
observations.state_before: Campaign 2595 just published to store2 (ACT-07-01-001), never before rendered storefront-side
observations.state_after: Campaign renders correctly with live mockup + clipart assets

observations.action: Inspect DOM structure of the personalization surface
observations.observed_result: Two separate injection points found: (1) #teeinblue-wrapper (attribute data-v-app='' — a Vue 3 mounted app) placed near the product gallery, rendering ONLY the artwork mockup as inline SVG plus hidden style blocks; (2) a separate personalization FORM injected directly inside the Shopify theme's native product form at path product-form.product-form > form.form > div.product-form__buttons.tee-form-wrapper > div#tee-artwork-form.tee-campaign.tee-campaign-v2.tee-customization-wrapper. The class 'tee-campaign-v2' on this form container is a direct, explicit DOM marker of SDK v2. The visible 'PERSONALIZE' section header (light-gray banner) appears directly below the Price and above the option fields, inside the product form, ABOVE the Preview/Add to cart/Buy it now buttons.

evidence_refs.note: Also confirmed via outerHTML dump captured during exploration (not persisted as separate file; class 'tee-campaign tee-campaign-v2 tee-customization-wrapper' read directly from live DOM)

observations.action: Select poster template option '2' (of 1/2/3, required field, no thumbnail images shown on the buttons themselves - just plain numbered boxes)
observations.observed_result: Selecting template 2 dynamically revealed 7 additional required fields not present/visible for the default state: Choose Woman's Skin Tone*, Choose Woman's Hairstyle*, Woman Name* (text, max 10 chars, live '0/10' counter), Choose Cat Breed #1*, Cat Name #1* (text, max 10), Choose Cat Breed #2*, Cat Name #2* (text, max 10). Skin Tone appeared pre-selected (one swatch highlighted) by default; Hairstyle did NOT have a default despite only 2 choices (Black/Red). This confirms a dependency: template choice controls which further personalization fields are required.
observations.state_before: No template selected, only base variant fields (Available Product/Color/Size) visible
observations.state_after: 8 total personalization fields visible and required for template 2

evidence_refs.note: Shows full required-field list with validation errors

observations.action: Select a top-level breed/hairstyle option (e.g. click radio label for 'British fold' under Choose Cat Breed #1)
observations.observed_result: Selecting the top-level radio (input[type=radio], role=radiogroup, 4 choices e.g. 'British fold'/'Long hair'/'Short hair'/'Sphynx') caused a NEW dependent field group to appear directly beneath it (DOM id pattern tee-field--layer-<id>-children, heading = the parent's selected value, e.g. 'British fold') containing a larger grid (9 items observed) of specific clipart image thumbnails (radio inputs) that must ALSO be selected. The parent field's own inline 'This field is required!' error message persisted visually attached to the parent heading even after the parent radio was checked, until the CHILD selection was also completed - i.e. validation treats parent+child as one logical required unit. Same two-level pattern observed for both 'Choose Cat Breed #1' and 'Choose Cat Breed #2', and for 'Choose Woman's Hairstyle' (fewer visible child options).
observations.state_before: Parent radio unselected, no child field rendered
observations.state_after: Parent radio selected + child field rendered but still unselected -> still invalid

observations.action: Click 'Add to cart' / 'PREVIEW' with one or more required (including nested child) fields incomplete
observations.observed_result: Client-side validation triggers synchronously (no page reload): each incomplete field shows a red 'This field is required!' line directly under its heading, and a global red message 'Error: Some fields are required or invalid data' appears just above the Add to cart button, near the PREVIEW button. No network request to /cart/add is made while validation fails (confirmed: no /cart/add entry in network log for these attempts).
observations.state_after: Inline + global validation errors shown, cart unchanged

observations.action: Click the 'PREVIEW' button (blue outline, above Add to cart)
observations.observed_result: Opens a centered modal overlay (dark backdrop) showing the current personalized artwork mockup at larger size, with left/right carousel arrows and a 'Close preview' button at the bottom. This is a distinct surface from the always-visible inline SVG mockup rendered inside #teeinblue-wrapper in the product gallery.
observations.state_after: Preview modal open, showing artwork matching current field selections

observations.action: Inspect the inline SVG artwork mockup (#teeinblue-wrapper > ... > svg.tee-mockup-artwork) and cross-reference layer ids against personalization field ids
observations.observed_result: SVG contains <g> elements with ids like 'artwork-layer--layer-937252' (a text layer, default text 'Abysse' before user edits) and 'artwork-layer--layer-224514' (an image layer). These numeric suffixes match exactly the personalization field ids 'tee-field--layer-937252' (Cat Name #1) and 'tee-field--layer-224514' (Choose Woman's Hairstyle) respectively - confirming a direct 1:1 input-field -> artwork-layer -> rendered-preview mapping by shared numeric layer id.

observations.action: Check all clipart/mockup image network responses for load failures
observations.observed_result: All teeinblue image assets (mockup thumbnails, clipart images, template thumbnails) returned HTTP 200 with complete:true and non-zero natural width/height. No 404/403 errors tied to teeinblue/cdn.ownego.com assets were observed in this session. This is notable given this is the very first render of campaign 2595 on store2 (just-published) - no 'still publishing'/broken-mockup state was observed, contrary to the possibility flagged by the orchestrator.

observations.action: Read displayed price before and after selecting template 2 and completing all personalization fields
observations.observed_result: Price displayed as '$55.99' both before any personalization selection and after completing all fields for template 2 - no additional-charge line or price change was shown in the UI for this specific template/option combination. A CSS variable --tee-additional-charge-bg-color exists in the widget's injected stylesheet, implying the add-on pricing UI feature exists in SDK v2 but was not observed active for this particular campaign/template/options (single sample - see unknowns).
observations.state_before: No personalization done, base price shown

observations.action: Complete all required + nested-dependent fields (template 2; Skin Tone default; Hairstyle=Black + first hairstyle thumbnail; Woman Name='QaWoman'; Cat Breed #1='British fold' + first thumbnail; Cat Name #1='Whiskers1'; Cat Breed #2='British fold' + first thumbnail; Cat Name #2='Mittens2'), then click 'Add to cart'
observations.observed_result: POST https://linh-explorer-2.myshopify.com/cart/add returned HTTP 200. Item added: variant_id 67776422019376 ('Vertical Framed Poster / Black / 12in x 18in'), quantity 1, price 5599 ($55.99, matches displayed price exactly - no hidden fee). Line item properties returned were ONLY: _customization_id (uuid), _customization_image (generated JPG preview URL on cdn.ownego.com), _tib_fulfilled_sku, _tib_design_link_1 (generated PNG design file URL). No plain-text personalization values (e.g. 'Woman Name: QaWoman') were present as visible/named cart properties.

observations.action: Navigate to /cart and inspect displayed line item
observations.observed_result: Cart page shows the mockup thumbnail image (reflecting the personalized design visually) plus ONLY the standard variant text: 'Available Product: Vertical Framed Poster', 'Color: Black', 'Size: 12in x 18in', price $55.99, quantity stepper, remove (trash) icon, subtotal $55.99 USD, 'Check out' button. None of the personalization inputs (Woman Name, Cat Names, breed/hairstyle choices, template number) are shown as text anywhere on the cart page - the only place they surface to the buyer is visually, baked into the generated mockup thumbnail image.

observations.action: Inspect the sections.cart-drawer HTML fragment returned in the /cart/add response
observations.observed_result: Uses standard Shopify Dawn-family theme cart-drawer markup: custom elements <cart-drawer>, <cart-drawer-items>, <quantity-input> (+/- stepper), <cart-remove-button>, a table with Product/Total/Quantity columns, subtotal '$55.99 USD', tax/shipping note, and a 'Check out' submit button. No teeinblue-specific customization of the cart drawer markup itself was observed - the drawer is theme-native; only the line item's mockup thumbnail carries teeinblue-generated content.

observations.action: Increase quantity from 1 to 2 via POST /cart/change.js {id: <line key>, quantity: 2}
observations.observed_result: HTTP 200, item_count became 2, total_price became 11198 (exactly 2x 5599) - linear price scaling for this single sample. No bulk/quantity discount observed.

observations.action: Cleanup: set quantity to 0 via POST /cart/change.js {id: <line key>, quantity: 0}
observations.observed_result: HTTP 200, cart verified empty afterward (item_count 0, total_price 0, items: []). No checkout/payment/order-creation step was performed at any point in this session.

feature_candidates: FEAT-07-storefront-buyer-facing: campaign publish -> product-linked storefront visibility (confirmed IMMEDIATE for store2 / SDK v2)
Inline multi-level personalization form embedded directly in Shopify native product-form (not a modal-triggered widget) for SDK v2
Dependent/nested required-field validation (parent breed/hairstyle choice reveals a child clipart-thumbnail choice, both required)
Live SVG-based artwork mockup with layer-id <-> field-id mapping
Cart line item personalization representation limited to internal generated-asset references (no visible text properties)

variant_and_option_matrix.note: Only one value seen selected/active; not confirmed if other product types exist for this campaign

variant_and_option_matrix.option: Poster - Woman and dog clipart template

artwork_preview_observations: Inline SVG mockup (#teeinblue-wrapper, Vue3 app) updates its <text>/<image> layers as personalization fields are filled - confirmed by layer-id/field-id correlation (SF-OBS-010).
Separate 'PREVIEW' modal surface shows a larger rendering of the same artwork with carousel navigation (SF-OBS-009).

No loading/error/fallback state was triggered during this session - all assets loaded on first attempt (SF-OBS-011); loading.svg placeholder element exists in DOM but was not observed in an active/stuck loading state.
pricing_observations: Base price $55.99 (5599 minor units) shown consistently pre- and post-personalization for template 2 (SF-OBS-012).
Cart price for qty 1 = 5599; qty 2 = 11198 (linear, SF-OBS-016) - single sample, not sufficient to confirm absence of tiered/bulk pricing rules generally.

No visible add-on/surcharge UI was triggered in this session despite the widget stylesheet defining an additional-charge color token - not enough evidence to say campaign 2595 never has add-on pricing (LOW confidence, see unknowns).
cart_handoff_observations: Add-to-cart, quantity update, and removal all completed successfully via standard Shopify AJAX cart endpoints (/cart/add, /cart/change.js) (SF-OBS-013, 016, 017).
Personalization values are NOT exposed as human-readable cart line item properties - only internal underscore-prefixed teeinblue references are attached (SF-OBS-013).
No path back to 'edit personalization from cart' was found or tested in this session (no edit/change-design link visible in cart page or drawer HTML) - coverage limitation.

evidence_refs.note: campaigns/15280333291824.json returned 200 on first-ever storefront load after publish, no delay or separate publish/cache step needed
All mockup/clipart assets loaded without error on first render, contradicting the 'still publishing' risk flagged by the orchestrator

coverage_limitations: Chỉ test template 2 trong 3 template khả dụng (1 và 3 chưa khám phá) - bộ field cá nhân hoá có thể khác nhau giữa các template.

Chỉ test 1 tổ hợp option cá nhân hoá (breed/hairstyle đầu tiên trong danh sách khi có nhiều lựa chọn) - chưa test các tổ hợp khác, chưa test giới hạn ký tự thực tế của các trường tên (chỉ quan sát bộ đếm '0/10', chưa test nhập quá 10 ký tự).
Chưa test đổi variant (Color=White, Size=24x36) và ảnh hưởng của nó tới personalization/preview/giá.
Chưa test buyer state LOGGED_IN, market/locale/currency khác mặc định, hoặc mobile viewport/browser khác.

Chưa quan sát trực quan việc cart drawer overlay tự mở sau add-to-cart (chỉ xác nhận qua HTML section trả về trong response add-to-cart, không chụp được overlay đang mở trên trang do chạy headless không trigger sự kiện mở drawer trong luồng script).
Chưa tìm thấy hoặc test đường quay lại 'edit personalization' từ cart - không rõ tính năng này có tồn tại trên SDK v2 hay không.
Không thực hiện bất kỳ bước checkout/payment/order nào - dừng đúng ranh giới theo chỉ định.

So sánh SDK v1 vs v2 dựa hoàn toàn trên quan sát độc lập của agent này trên store2; KHÔNG có quyền đọc kết quả song song của agent store1, nên các nhận định 'khác biệt' trong phần trả lời cuối là suy diễn của orchestrator dựa trên 2 báo cáo riêng biệt, không phải so sánh trực tiếp của storefront-explorer này.

conditions: Chỉ 1 template (2/3) và 1 tổ hợp option/variant đã được test đầy đủ tới add-to-cart; các tổ hợp còn lại là coverage gap, không phải lỗi.
Một số nhận định (add-on pricing, bulk discount, template khác) chỉ dựa trên 1 sample -> LOW confidence, đã ghi vào unknowns, không được dùng làm business rule.
allowed_next_steps: qa-knowledge-normalizer/feature-profile-builder có thể tiêu thụ SF-OBS-001..017 làm OBSERVED_CURRENT evidence cho FEAT-07-storefront-buyer-facing.
Nếu cần coverage đầy đủ hơn (template 1/3, variant khác, mobile, logged-in), cần một lượt storefront-explorer bổ sung.
Conflict về nhãn 'dog' vs 'cat' nên được đưa lên orchestrator/reviewer để quyết định resolution, không tự ý chọn phía đúng.
